title: Deep generative design with cryo-EM feedback yields a 47.6 nM gastric proton pump inhibitor
summary: Abe et al. designed candidate compounds in silico with deep generative models under pharmacophores taken from drug-bound gastric proton pump structures (workflow Deep Quartet), synthesized several, measured inhibition and solved binding poses by cryo-EM at up to 2.08 A. The best compound, DQ-18, has Ki 47.6 nM. Abstract-level review; comparison with non-AI design and preclinical development status not assessed.

evidence.tested: Candidates were synthesized, assayed in vitro and their binding poses determined by cryo-EM.
evidence.unknown: Selectivity, in vivo activity, hit rates versus baselines and full Methods were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep generative models proposed compounds matching structure-derived pharmacophores; cryo-EM results fed redesign.

source_review.scope: abstract and bibliographic metadata (Europe PMC) only; Methods and full text not assessed
